title: Chalk Hearts on the Prairie
moral: Kind actions can bring people together.

scenes.summary: Tommy rides across the prairie with his horse Dusty and loves drawing with chalk.
scenes.text: Tommy the cowboy rode his gentle horse Dusty across the wide warm plains and carried bright chalk to draw happy marks.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy riding horse across sunny prairie holding chalk, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Tommy meets new people who speak different languages but must find a way to connect.
scenes.text: Tommy met people who spoke different words but they needed to understand each other.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy and people smiling and gesturing with chalk drawings, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Tommy travels across the plains making friends and sharing drawings.
scenes.text: Tommy rode with Dusty meeting people and drawing colorful pictures to spread joy.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy and child drawing on rocks with chalk, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Tommy and his friends help guide sheep safely together.
scenes.text: A herd of sheep crossed the path and Tommy and his friends gently guided them safely.
scenes.image_prompt: people guiding sheep calmly across prairie, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Tommy leaves behind kindness and continues his journey happily.
scenes.text: Tommy left bright chalk marks and rode away knowing he had made the world kinder.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy riding into sunset leaving colorful chalk drawings on rocks, colorful cartoon children's book style

story: Tommy the cowboy rode his gentle horse Dusty across the wide warm plains and carried bright chalk to draw happy marks. Tommy met people who spoke different words but they needed to understand each other. Tommy rode with Dusty meeting people and drawing colorful pictures to spread joy.
